name: Fugleramme
description: The birds a BirdNET-Go or BirdWeather station heard, drawn by Fugleramme's own renderer as hand-coloured 1800s plates packed onto one page: the window's collage, the latest bird or the newest arrival. Plates are fetched from Fugleramme on first use. Demo garden until set up.

cell_options.name: source
cell_options.label: Detector
cell_options.help: Where the birds come from. Leave the address or the station empty for a demo garden, so every page can be tried first.

cell_options.name: address
cell_options.label: BirdNET-Go address
cell_options.help: Where BirdNET-Go's web page opens, for example http://birdnet.local:8080. Leave empty for a demo garden.

cell_options.name: password
cell_options.label: BirdNET-Go password (normally blank)
cell_options.help: Only when BirdNET-Go's Private Mode keeps the detections behind a login.

cell_options.name: station
cell_options.label: BirdWeather station
cell_options.help: A public station's number, or its page such as https://app.birdweather.com/stations/123. Up to five, separated by commas, are read as one. Leave empty for a demo garden.

cell_options.name: mode
cell_options.label: Page
cell_options.help: The collage packs every bird the window heard onto the page, each sized by its real body mass. The other two draw one plate, large, with its name under it.

choices.label: Collage: the birds heard in the window
Latest bird: the one calling now, with the time
Newest arrival: the latest first-ever species, with the date

cell_options.name: layout
cell_options.label: Layout
cell_options.help: Spiral grows out from the middle, so the page reads as a round cluster with bare corners. Voids puts each bird on the emptiest paper it fits, filling the corners too.

choices.label: Spiral: grows out from the middle
Voids: fills the emptiest spot first

cell_options.name: spotlight
cell_options.label: Spotlight the latest bird
cell_options.help: Draws the bird heard last large in the middle, with the rest packed round it.

cell_options.name: species_limit
cell_options.label: How many birds
cell_options.help: The most species on the page. With the numbered key on, at most 40.

cell_options.name: ranking
cell_options.label: Which birds, when there are more

cell_options.name: name_key
cell_options.label: Numbered key
cell_options.help: A number on each bird and the names listed in a key, below a portrait page or beside a landscape one.

cell_options.name: names
cell_options.label: Names in
cell_options.help: Common names are the ones the detector sends: BirdNET-Go's in whatever language it is set to, BirdWeather's in English. A bird it has no name for falls back to BirdNET's English label.

cell_options.name: second
cell_options.label: Second line
cell_options.help: A second name under the first, in parentheses.

cell_options.name: font
cell_options.label: Typeface
cell_options.help: Seven italics, fetched from Fugleramme the first time they are used. Cormorant Garamond suits the single-plate pages; its hairlines break up on a crowded collage.

cell_options.name: margin
cell_options.label: Margin
cell_options.help: Bare paper along each edge, as a share of the page's short side, for a mat that covers the panel's border. The single-plate pages keep at least 8%.

cell_options.name: paper
cell_options.label: Paper
cell_options.help: Flat is the page Fugleramme draws for its e-ink panel: an even paper tone and solid black names, which the panel's colours reproduce cleanly. Textured is its screen page, with paper grain that a colour e-ink panel turns into speckle.

cell_options.name: credit
cell_options.label: Credit line under the page
cell_options.help: Names the artists of the plates on the page, and Fugleramme, whose cut-outs they are (CC BY-SA 4.0).
